maya: Starting a background prefill stress probe on the new quant build (magnet32k-int4). Synthetic traffic + small concurrent inference load. Observed reproducible KV shadowing / context mismatch after ~12k tokens when background qps >=150.

oliver: Can you paste the command you used and any small log snippet?

maya: yeah, command:
```
./bench_prefill.sh --model magnet32k-int4 --window 32768 --seed 1234 --background-qps 150 --prefill-size 8192 --clients 4
```

maya: quick tail of the agent log:
```
[2026-03-20 14:02:11] PREFILL idx=8192 head=12011 tail=12011 kv_fp=0x3f2a...
[2026-03-20 14:02:12] INFER seq=12012 token=290 mismatch_ctx=1 client=2
[2026-03-20 14:02:12] KV_COLLISION detect=1 victim_idx=12011 donor_idx=31
```

zane: that 'victim_idx' line looks like wrap/aliasing. Did you run with any RoPE scaling tweaks? Could be rotation wrap + shard alignment issue.

maya: I tried rot_scale=0.999 and rot_scale=1.001 in the runtime config. rot_scale=0.999 reduced the rate but didn't eliminate the drift.

emma: simplest check: disable background-qps (set to 0) and see if pure prefill still diverges.

maya: ran with background-qps=0. No drift. Prefill-only is stable. So baseline prefill OK; interaction with concurrent traffic is suspect.

triage-bot: created INF-2145: "background-prefill KV aliasing under int4 with concurrent small requests" (assigned: eng-ml)

oliver: can you run an isolated reproducer with two clients writing disjoint prefixes but contending allocator? Maybe client_id or session_id is missing from the fingerprint used for allocation.

maya: will run that tonight. Also tried switching quant-mode to fp16: fp16 run shows zero drift; int4 shows drift immediately.

zane: that points at quant packing or memcpy alignment. In int4 we pack 2 tokens per byte or similar; concurrent memcpy could shift a byte if not aligned, causing off-by-one in KV indices.

oliver: good call. Add an instrumentation that dumps raw KV index table entries (small window) before and after background requests. Also try running with --no-batched-copies.

maya: added idx dumps and repeated. dump snippet:
```
KVIDX [12008..12016]: 0x01,0x01,0x3f,0x...  // before
KVIDX [12008..12016]: 0x01,0x01,0x3e,0x...  // after
```

maya: difference shows a single byte flip around index 12010 after a background client request overlapped with prefill copy.

ci-bot: scheduled job queued: prefill-collision-probe-1765432200 (matrix: int4|fp16 x rot_scale{1.0,0.999,1.001} x background-qps{0,50,150})

zane: next steps: reproduce with reduced thread count, try --no-batched-copies, and instrument DMA/memcpy paths for int4 packing. If confirmed, temporary mitigation: force aligned memcpy and client_id tag in kv fingerprint.

oliver: thx, keep updates here. If you get a minimal repro script post it and we'll run a bisect on runtime memcpy.

maya: will attach reproducer + raw dumps when done. thanks :thumbsup:

emma: nice find. cc @platform-infra in case we need to coordinate driver changes.

maya: ping me if you want the raw tarball, i'll upload to the ticket.
